pāśā iva bandhā bandhanahetavo yasmiṃstathāvidhasya cetasaḥ saṃsaraṇaṃ
saṃsārastasya taraṇe gatirupāyaḥ
idaṃ varṇitaprakāraṃ duḥkhaṃ bhavyamatervivekinaḥ pelavaṃ komalam

dehadvayābhimānatyāya eva taducchedopāya ityāśayenāha - dehātītā
ityādinā

cittattvaṃ paramātmā bandhaḥ
saṃsārastayoḥ kaḥ saṃbandhaḥ
utsaṅge aṅke iva uhyamānāni dhāryamāṇānyapi padmāni

pañcasu dehādyākārapariṇateṣu bhūteṣu kaśācandanādisaṃyukteṣu
strīputrādiviyukteṣu ca kṣatirduḥkhadiprasaktiḥ
tarhi jñājñayoraviśeṣaḥ kiṃ na syāttatrāha - ajñasyeti

pūrvaṃ
salilakāṣṭhopanyāsaḥ saṃsargābhāve dṛṣṭāntārtha iha tādātmyābhāve
ityapaunaruktyam

nanu sukhaduḥkhādisaṃvittiniṣedhe saṃvittyantarāprasiddheḥ śūnyatā
syādityāśaṅkyāha - sthiteti
śasaśchāndaso ḍādeśa. tā tā piṇḍānāṃ prajuhomītivat

dārūṇi kāṣṭhabhārā vāhyante uttāryante yayā tathāvidhā nauryathā svayaṃ
dārubhūtāpi
dārugataiśchedabhedadāhādiguṇadoṣairjalagataiścalanaparivartananairmalyapaṅk
ilatvādiguṇadoṣaiśca na tadvatī tathetyarthaḥ

adehasya dehaceṣṭāśūnyasyāpi svaputramṛtyayuddhādi paśyato jāgrato'pi
svapnādāviva kartṛtvaṃ vidyate

naiva kiṃcitkaromīti yukto manyeta tattvavit iti
bhagavadvacanāt

nahi citte kartṛtāśaktirnāsti yena dehaḥ kartā
kalpyetetyarthaḥ

taccorvaśyāsaktasya purūravasaḥ
prasiddhamindrāhalyākhyāne ca prākprapañcitamiti bhāvaḥ

saṃsaktityāgamātreṇa sarve jīvanmuktaguṇā manasi siddhyantītyāśayenāha -
antariti

sarvāntarasyātmano bahirbahiḥśliṣṭhānāṃ
pañcakośalakṣaṇānāṃ bhogyavargalakṣaṇānāṃ ca bandhabhūtānāṃ
sarvapadārthānāṃ nirāse idamevaikaṃ mukhyopāyatayā niścitaṃ
yatsarvaduḥkhakarīmantaḥsaktiṃ vivarjayet

yathā sthiramaṇiḥ
sphaṭikastannibhamambhaḥ arā niśitadhārā yeṣāṃ santi te ariṇaḥ khaḍgādaya
nīle yamunādivāriṇi militamekatvameti tadvadityarthaḥ
